featured_reviews.name: Sabah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing first interaction with Casa Bambino Montessori.

I contacted the school as a French parent newly arrived in Mumbai, looking for a Montessori environment for my 4-year-old son, who had previously attended a Montessori school in Paris. I wrote a detailed and respectful admission inquiry, asking about availability and information.

The response I received was extremely cold and abrupt: simply that there was no vacancy and therefore admission could not be granted. No brochure, no explanation, no waiting list option, no call, no alternative suggestion, no warmth whatsoever.

For a school working with very young children, I find this kind of communication quite revealing. A school’s first interaction with a parent says a lot about its culture, professionalism, and emotional sensitivity.

By comparison, other international schools in Mumbai and Bandra, even when full, took the time to call, explain, suggest options, and treat the family with respect.

For parents looking for a warm, emotionally safe, child-centered environment, I would strongly recommend paying attention not only to online reviews, but also to how the school communicates with you from the very first contact.

Based on my experience, I did not feel any warmth, care, or professionalism in the admissions response.

featured_reviews.review_text: We are very happy with Casa Bambino Montessori School. The teachers are loving, patient, and truly supportive. We have seen great positive changes in our son’s confidence and independence. It’s a wonderful place for early learning. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: darpan banthia
featured_reviews.review_text: Casa Bambino Montessori School laid the perfect foundation for my daughter, Durveka. One thing I really appreciated were all of the wonderful activities the teachers thought of to make learning fun. Beautiful pictures were shared with us often and teachers kept us updated with monthly detailing of all the learning that was happening in the classroom. The teachers Renu Aunty & Jesal Aunty, created a warm and rich educational environment. My daughter was greeted everyday with a smile and was excited about going to school. Upon pick up she would tell me about all of the wonderful toys she played with, the songs she sang and the books that were read aloud. If she was having a difficult transition they would always help her with a warm smile and check in with me as needed. I highly recommend Casa Bambino Montessori School, it is truly a gem of a school. My daughter learned phonics, number recognition, vowels, nursery rhymes & stories with such ease. I feel very proud and smile with joy to hear her speak in English. I am happy that Durveka will begin her new journey at JBCN International School.

featured_reviews.name: Porus Vakshoor
featured_reviews.review_text:
​My son Aoshnar Vakshoor attends the marine lines branch. Despite having full parental rights and paid the full tuition fees myself, this school chose to support a letter from the mother and has blocked me from accessing any information about my son's progress or well-being. They made this decision without requesting any official court document or legal proof—just based on a written request.
​This is a massive breach of trust and shows a shocking lack of awareness about parental rights.
​To make matters worse, when I called the Head Office to resolve this serious issue, the person I spoke with actually hung up on me and then refused to answer my subsequent calls.
​It's heartbreaking to be arbitrarily shut out of my child's life by his school, and their customer service response was appalling. Avoid this school if you are a co-parent.

featured_reviews.name: Ekta Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Da Vinci Montessori is a school which has made my child a thinker , communicator, also an empathetic little human. Leadership team and the teachers at Da Vinci Montessori are highly approachable and happy to meet the parents to help them understand phases of child development and how to navigate around it . With regular updates from the school we are constantly aware regarding the activities and tools used by the child at school and the learning outcome of the same . I would like to thank the school for all the efforts undertaken to create an environment which ensures the holistic development of the children.

A Montessori environment gives the child the opportunity to learn with concrete materials with a gradually increasing level of difficulty. DVM provides just that. Congratulations to Ashani for giving South Mumbai children an opportunity to carry on their learning in a very holistic manner...My son attended DVM 3 years later and  I have seen the same commitment from Ashani, Suchi and  the entire team.

Da Vinci Montessori makes school our home.
